title: WORKER_HEAVY=essential (fly.toml default) skips live_subnets and heavy schedulers
refutes_if: worker_heavy_feeds_enabled() returns True when WORKER_HEAVY=essential, or background_boot starts live_subnets under essential
fetch_method: git show ce3d820013d45577333ac8aada8c0d9e97c54129:internal/run_mode.py | nl -ba | sed -n '71,74p'; git show ce3d820013d45577333ac8aada8c0d9e97c54129:internal/background_boot.py | nl -ba | sed -n '552,556p'; git show ce3d820013d45577333ac8aada8c0d9e97c54129:fly.toml | nl -ba | sed -n '40p'

evidence.quote:
# WORKER_HEAVY=essential must not start live_subnets.
